question: Where is the headquarters of International Hockey Federation (FIH) located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Switzerland**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The International Hockey Federation (FIH) is headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland**__.

 __
 
• It is the international governing body of field hockey and indoor field hockey.
 
• It is responsible for major international hockey tournaments, especially the Hockey World Cup.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **International Hockey Federation (FIH)**

 
 
• President: Seif Ahmed
 
• Headquarters: Lausanne, Switzerland
 
• CEO: Thierry Weil
 
• Founder: Paul Léautey
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The** International Hockey Federation** was founded on 7 January 1924 in Paris by Paul Leute, who became the first president.

 
 
• It was established in response to the omission of field hockey from the schedule of the 1924 Summer Olympics.
 
• In total, there are 139 member associations within the five federations recognized by the FIH.
